title: Recycling rates (mid-level)
question:
The graph below shows the percentage of household waste that was recycled in four cities between 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
essay:
The line graph shows the percentage of household waste recycled in Ashford, Brenton, Calder and Dunmore from 2000 to 2020.

Ashford recycled 18% in 2000. In 2005 it was 26% and in 2010 it was 35%. In 2015 it was 41% and in 2020 it was 47%.

Brenton recycled 30% in 2000, then 32% in 2005 and 31% in 2010. In 2015 it was 36% and in 2020 it was 44%.

Calder started at 10% in 2000. It was 14% in 2005, 22% in 2010, 33% in 2015 and 52% in 2020.

Dunmore was 25% in 2000. In 2005 it was 24%, in 2010 22%, in 2015 21% and in 2020 20%.
